{{Quote|Welcome to the Rimmer's Rest, best cantina in all of Nar ''Shaddaa''.|The bouncer's welcome|audio=NarShaddBouncer-WelcometotheRimmersRest.flac|<ref name="AudioD" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''bouncer''' worked at the at the [[Rimmer's Rest/Legends|Rimmer's Rest]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. One of the bouncer's duties was welcoming patrons to the Rimmer's Rest via a practiced pitch that promoted the cantina as the best on Nar Shaddaa. During 5 ABY, the bouncer welcomed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]] to the establishment. The meeting between the two turned into a [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|shootout]], however, that ended when Katarn had cleaned the Rimmer's Rest out of 8t88's hired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I said a booth in the back. This is right here in the middle of the bar."<br />"Oh? It's all I got, take it or leave it."<br />"I'll take it.|Kyle Katarn and the bouncer|audio=NarShaddBouncer-BoothintheBack.flac|<ref name="AudioD" />}}
[[File:Katarn_meets_8t88.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The bouncer welcomed both Kyle Katarn and 8t88 to the Rimmer's Rest.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual worked as a [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] at the [[Rimmer's Rest/Legends|Rimmer's Rest]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. In addition to passing on beverage orders to the [[Bartender/Legends|server]] [[Timmy]], the bouncer also welcomed guests to the establishment with an oft-repeated pitch promoting the cantina as the best one the moon had to offer. The bouncer also took table reservations.<ref name="AudioD" />

During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="Date2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]] to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> the bouncer took a table reservation for a booth for a man named [[Kyle Katarn]]. However, he later allowed the booth to be given to a different patron. Around the same time, the cantina was patronized by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]], who the bouncer assured that the Rimmer's Rest was droid friendly as long as 8t88 had the [[Currency/Legends|cash]] to pay. However, when 8t88 attempted to inquire about [[Boba Fett/Legends|someone]] he was meeting at the bar, the bouncer refused to hear 8t88 out, as it involved getting into the business of strangers. Although 8t88 agreed with the sentiment, he nonetheless continued to ask until his contact found him instead.<ref name="AudioD" />

Roughly an [[Time/Legends|hour]] later, Katarn entered the establishment, only to learn that the bouncer had allowed his reserved booth to go to someone else. Instead of the booth, the bouncer directed Katarn to table number four and shouted Katarn's drink order, [[Novanian grog/Legends|Novanian grog]], across the noisy cantina to Timmy. Shortly thereafter Katarn met with 8t88, the latter of who had called the meeting, and engaged in business that quickly [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|turned violent]].<ref name="AudioD" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I am looking for&mdash;"<br />"''Ah'', da da duh, you gotta find him yourself. I make it my business to mind my own, you take my meaning?"<br />"Naturally.|8t88 learns the bouncer's motto on privacy.|audio=NarShaddBouncer-TakeMyMeaning.flac|<ref name="AudioD" />}}
The bartender had a friendly disposition to guests entering his bar and repeated a "welcome pitch" that promoted the Rimmer's Rest, although his tone when giving the pitch indicated a tiresome opinion of the phrase. Given the clandestine interactions of the patrons, the bartender made it a point to stay out of other people's affairs, and refused to hear out 8t88's reason for being at the cantina. Despite reserving a booth for Katarn in advance of his arrival, the bouncer nonetheless let the table pass on to another patron, to Katarn's annoyance. When given Katarn's drink order, the bouncer simply shouted it to the bartender.<ref name="AudioD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unnamed bouncer appeared in the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|audio adaption]] of the [[1997]] novella ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'', despite not appearing in the novella itself. The bouncer was portrayed by [[Tim Glovatsky]], and was credited as "Bar Bouncer."<ref name="AudioD" />
